sanity: Sanity collapsed. You are now one with the hold music.
You blue-screened emotionally. IT filed a ticket on you.
Your last coherent thought was 'have you tried restarting yourself?'
You achieved inner peace by leaving your body at the desk.
HR found you gently rocking and whispering 'QoS… QoS…'
You transferred yourself to voicemail and never came back.
A sticky note on your monitor now reads: FORMERLY A PERSON.
You asked the headset for a raise. The headset said no.
Coffee machine diagnosed you as 'unsupported legacy hardware.'
You muted the world. Permanently. The softphone still rings.
Facilities swept you into the shredder bin with the old badge printouts.
You tried to escalate your own mental state. Queue position: 4,291.
csat: CSAT hit zero. A customer reached through the softphone and punched you.
The boss promotes you to Customer. Congratulations on your demotion.
Survey results are in: you personally ruined someone's afternoon.
A one-star review manifested physically and bit your headset.
The IVR started crying. That's on you.
Caller ID now displays as 'Please Hold Forever.' It's about you.
NPS score: -100. Marketing framed it in the lobby.
A customer mailed you a brick with 'RE: your tone' written on it.
The Witch Boss made you read every angry survey aloud at stand-up.
You were invited to a 'listening session.' It was just yelling.
CSAT dashboard flatlined. Someone brought a crash cart for the chart.
Users formed a support group called Survivors of Your Advice.
queue: Queue hit 100. The ticket system achieved sentience and fired you.
The backlog formed a union and voted you out.
Tickets stacked high enough to blot out the sun. You were crushed.
Management renamed the queue 'your problem' and went to lunch.
Auto-ack replied to itself 10,000 times. You were collateral.
Not enough work got done. The tickets filed a complaint about you.
Your inbox achieved critical mass and opened a black hole.
SLA clocks synchronized just to shame you in unison.
The queue grew faster than you typed. Evolution won.
Boss: 'We needed heroes.' Points at the pile. 'We got a pile.'
Every unanswered ticket learned your name. They chanted it.
You were replaced by a blinking cursor. Productivity went up.
won: 5:00 PM. You clock out with a thousand-yard stare and lukewarm coffee. Victory.
You survived. Your reward is doing it again tomorrow.
Shift complete. The queue waves goodbye. Menacingly.
You made it. Santa nods once. No other acknowledgment is permitted.
Clocked out. Somewhere, a softphone weeps in relief.
You lived. The tickets did not forgive you. They merely waited.
End of day. CSAT is 'fine,' which in Tier 1 means 'not on fire.'
You beat the clock. The Witch Boss pretends not to notice.
Survived 9 to 5. Your chair will remember this trauma.
Victory lap is a limp to the parking lot. Still counts.
